name: Shimmer Reverb
tip: The reverb plugin: plate, hall, shimmer plate, shimmer hall and velvet.

name: Shimmer Delay
tip: The delay plugin: echoes that climb (or fall) in pitch with every repeat.

name: FX and Routing
tip: Route the reverb and delay (one, the other, in series or in parallel) and add saturation, squash, duck and width.

name: Main preset
tip: One preset for the whole plugin: it sets the reverb, the delay and the FX and routing tabs together. The preset list at the top still has the presets of the tab you are on.

name: Save main preset
tip: Saves everything on all three tabs as one preset (stays on this device).

name: Test signal
tip: Pick what the preview rig plays into the plugin. 'Single click' is the cleanest way to hear a reverb tail or the echo train. 'Your file' uses the file you loaded.

name: Play
tip: Start or stop the test signal. Shortcut: Space.

name: Load file
tip: Load your own audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg). It stays in this browser tab and is never uploaded.

name: Clear tail
tip: Empties the reverb or delay tail at once, like stopping and restarting the transport.

name: Input trim
tip: Level into the plugin, like the gain of the track in your DAW. Double-click resets.

name: Compare: bypass
tip: Hear the unprocessed signal at the same moment. This is the preview rig, not a plugin control.

name: Decay
tip: Decay: how the tail fades, measured from the real DSP with an impulse. Yellow dot: drag sideways for Decay and up or down for Size. Cyan: pre-delay. Blue: damping. Orange: shimmer amount. Pink slider: mix. The purple curve follows while you drag. Shortcut: 1.

name: Tone
tip: Tone: live spectrum before (grey) and after (colour). Drag the lines to set the damping and the wet high-pass and low-pass. Shortcut: 2.

name: Type
tip: Plate: bright and dense, short to medium. Hall: bigger and smoother. Shimmer Plate and Shimmer Hall add a pitch shifted copy into the tail. Velvet: two halls blended, soft and dark to bright with Colour.

name: Decay
tip: Length of the tail. The Decay display shows the real result in seconds, measured from the DSP. Double-click resets.

name: Size
tip: Scales the delay lines: a small room or a big one. Bigger sounds slower and less dense. Double-click resets.

name: Pre-delay
tip: Gap before the tail starts. Keeps the dry sound clear. Around 200 ms suits a lead. Double-click resets.

name: Modulation
tip: Slow movement inside the tail that stops it sounding metallic. Double-click resets.

name: Velvet colour
tip: Velvet type only: negative is darker, positive is brighter. Double-click resets.

name: Pitch
tip: Pitch of the shimmer copy that feeds back into the tail. +12 is an octave up. Double-click resets.

name: Amount
tip: How much of the tail is shifted and fed back. The plugin limits the total so it cannot run away. Double-click resets.

name: Pitch 2
tip: Second shimmer pitch. +7 is a fifth up. Double-click resets.

name: Amount 2
tip: Amount of the second shimmer voice. 0 means it is off. Double-click resets.

name: Damping
tip: How fast the highs die away inside the tail. Lower is darker and warmer. Also draggable on the Tone view. Double-click resets.

name: Wet HP
tip: Removes lows from the reverb only. Around 200 to 300 Hz keeps a lead tail clean. Also draggable on the Tone view. Double-click resets.

name: Wet LP
tip: Removes highs from the reverb only. Also draggable on the Tone view. Double-click resets.

name: Mix
tip: Dry/wet. 0 is the dry signal only, 100 % is the reverb only. Double-click resets.

name: Peak reset
tip: Clears the held peaks and the clip light. Shortcut: R.

name: Window 100 %
tip: Window size. Drag any edge or corner of the plugin to resize it; the shape stays the same. Double-click here for 100 %.

name: Resize
tip: Drag to resize the window. Every edge and corner works, and the shape stays the same.
